title: dryopteris laterepens
intro: Dryopteris laterepens, commonly known as the American goldenback fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dryopteris laterepens include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
